# Brand files

- `readme-banner-dark.png` and `readme-banner-light.png`: the banner at the top of the root `README.md`, one per colour scheme.
- `social-preview-dark.png`: the social preview image; GitHub takes it only from the repository's settings, so it is uploaded there by hand.
- `openhora-mark.svg` and `openhora-favicon.svg`: the owl mark in full and simplified; the colour pair of the brand is `#6B4429` (light) and `#C99A6E` (dark).
- The brand's source of truth is the maintainer's brand project; these are the published copies (the SVGs and PNGs without their content-credentials metadata).
